events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect board probes and task directory
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/*.mjs | head -50; ls workshop-plan/tasks | head -50; git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs; head -40 workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs; grep -n "sandbox\|pass.py rm\|argv\|--live" workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the public board probe in live mode
events.input: $ cd workshop-plan && (node probe-public-board.mjs --live 2>&1 | tail -120); echo "EXIT ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; date
